novel_features.name: Bounded date-window discovery

novel_features.name: Evidence-backed family fact card

novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this before deciding whether published family facts meet a requirement.

novel_features.name: Qualified charge and application comparison
novel_features.description: Compare separate fee statements, payment conditions and explicit application intervals.
novel_features.rationale: Aligns unlike spot and event facts while retaining qualifiers and availability uncertainty.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this to compare published costs and deadlines without assuming a total or seat availability.

novel_features.name: Family-constraint comparison
novel_features.description: Compare selected outings against age, requested amenities and a trip date using supported, excluded and unknown states.
novel_features.rationale: Builds an evidence matrix across normalized spot and event records.

novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this for a small family shortlist that needs explicit constraints.

novel_features.name: Offline shortlist with retained coverage

novel_features.rationale: Joins normalized local records to the bounded collection that produced them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this to revisit saved records without network access.

narrative.headline: Iko-yo Trip: find selected family trips and compare published dates, fees and explicit family facts.
narrative.value_prop: Discover Iko-yo Trip’s local experiences and municipal events, inspect evidence, and compare a small family shortlist. Keyword and date filters apply only to the reported bounded listing window; cached records retain their observation times. The full core Iko-yo catalog is not integrated.
narrative.auth_narrative: The supported Trip pages use ordinary public HTTP and need no account or API key. Source records are published information, not live availability.

quickstart.comment: Check the local CLI setup without a network request.
Read one Saitama event listing page and inspect its coverage.
Inspect published age, facilities and qualified child/adult fees.

quickstart.command: iko-yo-pp-cli trip compare spots/8220 events/8412 --on 2026-11-15 --age-months 24 --amenities indoor,nursing --agent
quickstart.comment: Compare the selected facts and expose unknown requirements.
Revisit facts saved by earlier source reads.

troubleshoots.symptom: No matches in a bounded discovery window.
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect coverage and unknown-date counts, then increase trip discover --max-pages up to 5 or choose a source prefecture; this result does not establish source-wide absence.

troubleshoots.symptom: An amenity, age band or event schedule is unknown.
troubleshoots.fix: Use trip inspect for the selected reference and follow its source/official links; missing evidence does not mean absent or eligible.
Use the supported Trip commands; the core catalog is outside this integration.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for selected Iko-yo Trip family spots, municipal events and local experiences across Japan. It is useful when event dates, separate fees, application conditions or explicit family facilities affect a small shortlist. Report the bounded source window and preserve unknown facts.
anti_triggers: Full core Iko-yo catalog or core age-filter search
Bookings, payments, reviews, posts or account changes
Live seat availability or guaranteed age/accessibility suitability
